cases.question: I remember trying to connect to Wi-Fi on an aircraft. How fast did the airline describe the speed?
cases.reference: Onboard bandwidth typically ranges from 1 to 3 Mbps on Boeing 777s and some A380s, and is often below 1 Mbps on most A380s, depending on satellite coverage and location.
